back_translation: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name, for You have done wonders — plans determined long ago — in sure and steadfast faithfulness.
For You have made the city into a heap of rubble, the fortified town into a desolate ruin; the fortress of foreigners will be a city no more, and it will never be rebuilt forever.
Therefore a strong people will give glory to You; the city of ruthless nations will revere You.

For You have been a strong shelter for the poor, a strong shelter for the needy in his distress, a refuge from the rainstorm and a shade against the heat, when the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall.
Like scorching heat in a dry land, You subdue the uproar of foreigners; as heat is quenched by the shade of a cloud, the song of the ruthless is pressed into silence.

And on this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare an abundant banquet for all the peoples: a feast of well-aged wine, a feast of the finest food rich with marrow, and well-aged wine strained until pure and clear.
And on this mountain He will swallow up the face-covering veil that covers all peoples, the woven sheet that covers all nations.
He will swallow up death forever! And the Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face, and He will remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth, for the LORD has spoken.
And in that day it will be said: "Behold, this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD; we have waited for Him. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation."
For the hand of the LORD will rest at peace on this mountain, but Moab will be trampled down in his place, like straw trampled down into a dung pit.
He will spread out his hands in the midst of that pit, as a swimmer spreads his hands to swim, but He will press down his pride together with the skill of his hands.
And the towering fortress of your walls He will bring down low, casting it down to the ground, even to the dust.
